title: Wild AG footer
description: A quiet one-row footer under a 2px hairline: the gradient wordmark at the left; at the right a small sand-coloured line of notes split by slashes (copyright, credits with taupe links, a follow-us label) and two round taupe social buttons that turn sand on hover. On phones everything stacks, centred.
notes: socials take any icon (lucide or your own)
